known_limitations: Completion records do not all carry explicit validation result fields, so the dashboard classifies unavailable result evidence as unknown and uses conservative textual inference where present.
pull_request_not_applicable_reason: Live PR metadata unavailable in local-first historical validation; completion evidence derived from repository artifacts.
summary: Created a Validation Metrics Dashboard that reads existing work package completion records and validation observation artifacts, aggregates pass/conditional/fail counts, observation and defect counts, trend data, source links, and graceful empty-state warnings, plus a CLI command and tests.
